title: How to stop the Zone Read

beats.narration: Pistol formation. Quarterback at four yards, back right behind him.
Zone read. They leave your end unblocked and let the quarterback read him.
The answer? A scrape exchange. Your end crashes hard on the running back.
But watch the Will linebacker. He swaps jobs and scrapes outside.
Quarterback sees the crash, pulls it, and runs right into the Will.
Scrape exchange. Make the read wrong every time.
